title: Ergotropy of nonequilibrium steady states beyond the full secular approximation
summary: Understanding the generation and activation of ergotropy, the maximum work extractable by cyclic unitary operations, is central to quantum battery research. Positive-temperature thermal states are passive, whereas nonequilibrium environments can sustain nonpassive steady states with nonzero ergotropy. However, the full secular approximation commonly used in Lindblad descriptions can suppress steady-state coherence and obscure its contribution to ergotropy.
